ticket: Agent online 01 (wave 1): Project Manager (8), upgraded in place
title: The Project Manager (8), upgraded in place: it proposes what comes first and notices work that has sat 3 days
why: Jason, 2026-11-28, through the CEO: "Bring each one online individually… just in case we run out of usage". Agent 01 of 42. Goal: the transition cutover by Dec 15 (the team scales claims toward the ladder). It runs on staging's runner only (decisions/0179), costs $0, and every action has Undo.

changes.what: Two new Project Manager steps beside its gate. Sequence proposes a ticket's priority from what depends on it (a ruling's precedent, its goal's priority, the most urgent ticket waiting on it): always a proposal, never over a priority a person set. Stall: a Priority 1 or 2 Work ticket idle 3 days at its stage gets one "Unstick task #N" ticket in its lane (a proposal at Planning; from Building on it opens it, with Undo that withdraws it). If that sits 3 days too, it asks a session once.

Its charter (what it follows, its job, what it knows, when it escalates, what it never does) and its order of reasoning: code first, the agents' paid API only once its own budget exists (off today), then a session.

The decision tree's rules change (two steps, the reasoning order, the 3 days), so on staging the tree's approval is cleared and every role works at the Planning ceiling until the Founder approves the tree again, as decisions/0180 sets.
The FAQ says who keeps the work moving and whether the Project Manager uses AI.
